description: GMM project tracker: public projects with status, value, employer and contractor, newest first. Optionally one status, e.g. under-construction or delayed. Paginates: when more results remain, the structured answer has a nextCursor (absent on the last page). To continue, call this tool again with the same arguments and cursor set to that value.

cursor.description: Continue a previous result: the nextCursor it returned, unchanged. Only valid with the same other arguments (limit may differ).

status.description: announced, procurement, contracted, under-construction, delayed, on-hold, completed or cancelled.

name: list_projects

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page: pass it back as the cursor argument, with the same other arguments. Absent on the last page.

title: List tracked projects
